verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's docs describe 'nodes' — companion macOS/iOS/watchOS/Android/headless devices that pair with the Gateway and expose a command surface including camera.*, device.*, screen, notifications, and system controls, plus a 'computer use' tool letting the agent see/control the Gateway's own desktop or a paired node's desktop. Companion apps exist for Linux, Windows Hub, macOS, and mobile (iOS/Android), matching the cross-device reach the story describes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that camera, screenshot, notification, and media-playback control actually work reliably across paired devices in practice (evidence is entirely first-party docs).
